Reference

Requirements for WIT and ABI

This page lists every normative rule of the WIT contract and the binary interface of ilium:plugin@0.1.0. Each row has an id, the rule, the page that explains it, and the test that proves it. The ids appear inline as [ABI-NNN] on the pages that state the rule. The contract is in the WIT reference.

What you need

  • The WIT reference. WIT reference is the owner of all type definitions.
  • The conformance matrices. Host conformance matrix lists the members that rule ABI-030 covers.

Rules

Id Rule Owner page Test
ABI-001 The WIT reference is the only canonical definition of the contract. Other pages MUST hold excerpts only. reference-wit check.py excerpt check
ABI-002 Case order and case counts of event (56), intent (42), outcome (7), widget (51), action-kind (17), action-value (12), error-code (15) and deactivation-reason (6, of which five are delivered) MUST match the WIT reference. reference-wit case-count diff against wit/since_v0_1
ABI-003 All seven WIT packages MUST carry the one version 0.1.0 and change together. reference-abi-evolution package version scan
ABI-004 Each component MUST carry the custom section ilium:api-version with bytes 00 00 00 01 00 00. reference-abi-evolution inspect a built component
ABI-005 A WIT excerpt on another page MUST match the declared names and cases in the WIT reference. reference-wit check.py excerpt check
ABI-006 The optional exports a component has MUST equal the optional exports its manifest lists. reference-manifest install a component with an extra export
ABI-007 The manifest exports list MUST NOT differ from the component. A difference MUST refuse install with manifest.exports-mismatch. reference-host-conformance install with a missing optional export
ABI-008 A plugin that returns more than 256 submissions MUST trap the call; the host MUST apply none and none completes. reference-runtime-model return 257 submissions
ABI-009 The lowest-index offender of a batch-level check MUST complete as refused(invalid-argument) (shape) or refused(not-permitted) (grant), and every other submission MUST complete as refused(cancelled) with the message 'batch refused: submission ', where index is 0-based. requests-and-outcomes batch of 3 with 1 bad
ABI-010 A dedup key MUST be 1 to 128 characters from [A-Za-z0-9._:/-] and is mandatory for send-input and agent-action. events-and-intents repeat a key twice
ABI-011 Correlation numbers below 2^63 MUST belong to plugins. Numbers from 2^63 up belong to the SDK. reference-runtime-model submit with a high number
ABI-012 The host MUST hold a finished slow-call result for 30 seconds. requests-and-outcomes take after 31 s
ABI-013 The host MUST allow 64 pending requests by default per plugin (ceiling 256 for T1) and 4,096 per session. Over the limit MUST return busy. reference-errors-and-limits start 65 requests
ABI-014 A take before completion, a second take, or a take of an unknown id MUST return none. The SDK wrapper returns not-found. requests-and-outcomes take twice
ABI-015 Each event case MUST follow its delivery policy: coalesced, drop-oldest-counted or never-dropped. Loss of a drop-oldest event MUST be reported in events-dropped. reference-host-conformance fill a queue of 1,024
ABI-016 Names MUST use kebab-case in WIT. JSON inside strings MUST be UTF-8. reference-wit scan
ABI-017 A string that is not valid UTF-8 MUST trap the call. reference-runtime-model pass bad bytes
ABI-018 Required exports (lifecycle, handler, renderer) MUST NOT be listed in the manifest exports. reference-manifest list handler in a manifest
ABI-019 Cases of a variant, enum or flags MUST only be appended after the freeze. Records MUST NOT gain fields. reference-abi-evolution case-order diff
ABI-020 The Rust and TypeScript SDKs MUST map WIT names by the rules in the WIT reference section 10. reference-wit SDK binding test
ABI-021 The host MUST compare api versions by minor window and MUST report one refusal code per package, the first failing check. reference-abi-evolution install a 0.3.0 package
ABI-022 Version 0.1.0 MUST have exactly four unstable features: ui-calendar, plugin-services, gpu-kernels and websocket. reference-abi-evolution list features
ABI-023 A requested grant not in the API MUST refuse with manifest.grant-unknown. An unrequested import MUST refuse with manifest.import-not-requested. A call of an unrequested capability MUST trap host.capability-not-requested. reference-host-conformance three installs
ABI-024 The host MUST NOT link wasi:sockets or wasi:http. security import wasi:sockets
ABI-025 Each plugin side MUST run one single-threaded instance, and a host call MUST NOT re-enter a plugin export. reference-runtime-model call an export from an import
ABI-026 The host MUST interrupt a running export by an epoch ticker of 10 ms against the export deadline. reference-runtime-model spin in on-events
ABI-027 A memory growth over the instance limit MUST trap. reference-runtime-model grow memory
ABI-028 The deactivation reason crash-restart is reserved. The host MUST NOT deliver it. reference-abi-evolution crash a plugin
ABI-029 The host MUST NOT deliver an event, outcome or reason case to a plugin whose API predates the case. reference-abi-evolution run a plugin built against 0.1.0 on a host that adds a case after it
ABI-030 A host test suite MUST have a test for every row of the import, export, event, intent and widget matrices. reference-host-conformance row count check
ABI-031 The kernel MUST run two batch-level checks over the whole submission list in index order before any effect: shape first, then grant. Inside one submission shape wins over grant. events-and-intents batch with a missing grant at index 1 and a bad shape at index 2 -> index 2 is invalid-argument only if checked first; the shape check runs for the whole list before the grant check, so index 2 is the offender and the others are cancelled
ABI-032 Every check other than shape and grant (target, readiness, value validity, rate, quota, conflict, if-current) MUST be per submission and MUST affect only that submission. events-and-intents batch of 3 with a stale revision at index 1 -> only index 1 is refused
ABI-033 A full queue MUST admit a drop-oldest event by evicting the oldest queued drop-oldest event of any kind and counting it. reference-runtime-model fill a queue of 1,024 with output-matched, send 1,500 -> 477 dropped counted
ABI-034 A dedup key MUST be reserved while now_wall_ms - accepted_wall_ms < 600,000, measured on the wall clock and persisted in the journal. requests-and-outcomes repeat a key at 599,999 ms (duplicate) and at 600,000 ms (accepted); restart the server between
ABI-035 A repeated dedup key MUST complete as duplicate naming the ref of the first submission. The host MUST NOT check correlation uniqueness. requests-and-outcomes submit a key twice with the same correlation -> two completions
ABI-036 events-dropped MUST be coalesced by (event, source) and MUST never be dropped. reference-runtime-model drop two kinds twice -> one events-dropped event with two records
ABI-037 The hold of a slow-call result MUST start when on-events returns for the batch that delivered the request-completed event. requests-and-outcomes delay the batch by 40 s -> take still succeeds
ABI-038 After a trap, surviving events MUST be redelivered once at the head of the new queue, completions of submissions MUST be delivered to the new instance, and completions of call(id) requests MUST be discarded. reference-runtime-model trap with a pending submission and a pending http call
ABI-039 A coalesced event MUST NOT be reported in events-dropped when its queued event is merged. reference-events-and-intents send 2,000 screen-changed -> no events-dropped
ABI-040 A request-id MUST be unique per plugin side for the whole server run, start at 1 at server start, and never be reused, also across restarts. requests-and-outcomes restart a plugin -> new ids exceed the old ones
ABI-041 A request MUST count toward pending_requests from the return of its id to the enqueue of its completion; refused submissions and synchronous calls MUST NOT count. reference-errors-and-limits 64 slow calls then a refused submission -> count stays 64
ABI-042 The instance deadline of a call with deadline d ms MUST be ceil(d / 10) + 1 ticks, so a spinning guest traps in [d, d + 20] ms and a call that returns at d - 1 ms never traps. reference-runtime-model spin with d = 20 -> trap in [20, 40] ms
ABI-043 On revocation, synchronous calls needing the grant MUST return err(revoked), pending requests needing it MUST complete failed(revoked) before deactivate(revoked), and other pending call(id) requests MUST be cancelled with the instance. reference-runtime-model revoke http with one http and one fs request pending
ABI-044 A deactivate breach or trap MUST drop the instance and its bytes and MUST NOT count as a failure. Returned bytes over 1 MiB MUST be dropped with one warn line and MUST NOT count as a failure. reference-runtime-model breach deactivate three times -> plugin still restarts
ABI-045 A batch MUST hold at most 256 events, and event_queue MUST default to 1,024 with a ceiling of 4,096 for T1 and 1,024 for T2 and T3. reference-runtime-model deliver 600 queued events -> 3 batches
ABI-046 Events produced while a plugin activates MUST be queued and delivered in the first batch after activate returns ok, and MUST be discarded without events-dropped if activate fails. reference-events-and-intents emit pane-created during activate
ABI-047 After every activation of a plugin that holds tree.read, the first batch MUST start with one tree-changed event listing every node in pre-order. reference-events-and-intents activate with 3 nodes -> one event, 3 ids
ABI-048 An effectful import called inside views.render, annotate or settings-validate MUST return err(not-permitted) with the message 'effectful import in a pure call', and the call MUST continue. reference-runtime-model call intents.submit inside views.render
ABI-049 The host MUST NOT call an export of an instance while another export of that instance is on the stack. reference-runtime-model call an export from an import
ABI-050 A services.call to the caller's own service and an invoke-command for the caller's own command MUST be queued and run as later calls. reference-runtime-model invoke own command inside on-events
ABI-051 Every WIT function that returns request-id MUST have an awaiting wrapper with the WIT name and a starting wrapper with the suffix _request in Rust and Request in TypeScript. A WIT name that ends in -json MUST keep the suffix as _json in Rust and Json in TypeScript. reference-wit SDK binding test: list the wrappers of http, jobs, services, inference and settings

How the rows are tested

Three kinds of test cover the rows.

  1. Static checks. _tools/check.py compares each labelled WIT excerpt with the WIT reference (ABI-001, ABI-005). A diff of case order against the frozen snapshot covers ABI-002, ABI-003 and ABI-019.
  2. Install tests. A test installs a crafted package and expects the refusal code (ABI-004, ABI-006, ABI-007, ABI-018, ABI-021, ABI-023, ABI-024).
  3. Runtime tests. A fake host runs a plugin that breaks the rule and the test expects the trap, the refusal or the outcome (ABI-008 to ABI-017, ABI-025 to ABI-050).

Rust

use ilium_plugin_sdk::testing::FakeHost;

#[test]
fn more_than_256_submissions_trap() {
    let mut host = FakeHost::new();
    host.grant("tree.write");
    let result = host.run_on_events_returning(257);
    assert!(result.is_trap());
    assert_eq!(host.applied_count(), 0);
}

TypeScript

import { createFakeHost } from '@ilium/plugin-sdk/testing';

test('more than 256 submissions trap', () => {
  const host = createFakeHost();
  host.grant('tree.write');
  const result = host.runOnEventsReturning(257);
  expect(result.trapped).toBe(true);
  expect(host.appliedCount()).toBe(0);
});

Edge cases

  • A batch of exactly 256 submissions is valid.
  • A dedup key of 129 characters is a malformed submission, so the whole batch is refused (ABI-009, ABI-010).
  • A take at 30 s plus one tick returns none (ABI-012, ABI-014).
